integrity: The infinite theorem is established by a direct structural proof. Exhaustive finite enumeration is used only as an independent stress test, not as evidence for unbounded parameters.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns connected bipartite forbidden graphs with at least two edges and finite connected complete multipartite hosts. The frugal/star special case \(s=1\) overlaps known literature and is not claimed as new. Database and literature searches cannot exclude every alternate terminology or uncatalogued source.
title: Exact forbidden-bichromatic coloring of complete multipartite graphs
